outcomes_first_applicable: NO_RUN: B0/B0prime_DRY/B0prime_RERUN/B0_FA/B1/B2/B3 fails (B2/B3 failure = IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT of the gate); next: fix and re-review
NUMERICS_UNCERTIFIED: EPS uncertified or DOUBLING fails; NON_LAPSE_TAIL_MATERIAL: LO fails (LO_NGC for NGC readings); next: named successor

UNDECIDABLE_ROUTE_A_TAIL: a test using any run flagged TAIL_SOURCE_UNDERCONVERGED is read only as undecidable (it cannot yield IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT, NOT_UV_RESIDUAL, SOURCE_REPRESENTATION_K_DEPENDENT or FLOOR_LIKE); next: rerun that case with seed source_rtol/10
UNDECIDABLE_AT_ITERATION_FLOOR: a paired test still undecidable after R-PAIR is read only as undecidable (neither pass nor fail); no adoption
IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT: T2 decidable and fails; stop, T1/T3 not read as physics
SOURCE_RULE_MATERIAL: T2c fails; root ruling on the gas rule before adoption
KBIG_NOT_CONVERGED: T3 fails; production K_big 64 under T3prime (32/64/128), EPS and LO to 128
BOUND_INSUFFICIENT: RB_FP or SRB_ROT fails; next: q-corrected shell (second asymptotic order), design successor

FLOOR_LIKE (D14): T1 fails only by the contraction clause with Dhat_T(2,3) <= 1 and Dhat_T(3,4) <= 1; takes precedence over the two T1-fail readings below; a floor clause needs a new prereg version before any further case
NOT_UV_RESIDUAL: T1 fails AND T2c <= tau_i/4 every row AND SR-K pairwise K-dependence (2,3),(3,4) <= tau_i/4 AND no TAIL_SOURCE_UNDERCONVERGED flag; next: column/Picard map, own prereg
SOURCE_REPRESENTATION_K_DEPENDENT: T1 fails otherwise; next: fixed-point SR runs C2T-SR/C3T-SR/C4T-SR (packets over the smooth source), own design and prereg
HIGHER_K_DISAGREEMENT: T1 passes and T1_H fails; adopt nothing; C6T candidate under a V007 amendment sealed before further results
SHAPE_DISAGREEMENT: T1_S fails; review per-stage C wiring
FLAG_PENDING_RULING: every gate and test passes but a flag stays unruled (SOURCE_QUADRATURE_MATERIAL, or TAIL_SOURCE_UNDERCONVERGED on an adoption run); no adoption; root rules on the flag
